The id grid

This column is placed by an id-keyed grid rule, and it comes first in the markup while sitting second on screen.

A section

If the clone keeps the ids, the two columns land where the page puts them and the preview shows the article. If it does not, auto-placement swaps them and this text ends up on the left under the sidebar.

Lower down

More text below the spacer, so the preview has something to show wherever the pointer is.

Sidebar

Navigation and tools live here on the page, and must stay here in the clone.
